history.summary: A well-sized 1,410 sqft 3BR freehold in D05 Pasir Panjang (Village @ Pasir Panjang, TOP 2016) at $2.299M / $1,631 PSF — slightly below the $1,658 URA median and on the efficiency frontier. The catch is weak 2.20%/yr resale appreciation on a reliable 29-transaction base, and no walkable MRT listed.
history.rating_rationale: This is the most attractively priced FH 3BR in the batch on a PSF basis: $1,631 asking sits just under the $1,658 URA median, the unit is a genuine 1,410 sqft family layout (not a squeezed shoebox), the $2.299M quantum is liquid, it is on_frontier, and the best score (552) in the batch. Tempering that, the 29-transaction URA base shows soft 2.20%/yr appreciation — D05 Pasir Panjang has lagged the broader RCR — and the absence of a walkable MRT caps upside. Fair value plus good liquidity, but muted growth keeps it Neutral rather than a Buy.
